page.overview:
Who is Pervinca Took?

Pervinca Took was a sister of Peregrin Took.

Born in TA 2985 (SR 1385), she was the third daughter of Paladin II Took and Eglantine Banks, and the sister closest in age to Peregrin Took. She attended Bilbo Baggins' Bilbo's Farewell Birthday Party.
